milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the cow pen (center ~5, 0, 5) and face toward it. The cows are summoned at (5,1,5) and (4,1,6) inside the fenced pen. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the cow area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The anvil is placed at (-2, 0, 2) near the workstation area. The player must approach within 16 blocks and face toward the anvil. This correctly models 'player can see the anvil' without requiring them to stand on top of it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='mob', max_count=2) because this is a kill/combat task. Exactly 3 sheep are spawned in the scene. Successfully hunting (killing) at least one sheep means at most 2 remain alive in the detection area. The box is very generous (±15 on X/Z, -2 to +10 on Y) to ensure sheep are always detected regardless of wandering, preventing false positives from a sheep simply walking out of a small box.
